supplied_requirements.envelope: Maximum diameter 38.0 mm; overall height 18.0 mm including 2.0 mm front hub.
supplied_requirements.grip: Six equally spaced shallow scallops; minimum grip diameter >=33.0 mm; nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds; subtle raised dots without glove catches.
supplied_requirements.socket: Concentric 10.0 mm blind D socket based on a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm flat-to-far-round shaft, with 0.20 mm radial and flat clearance; >=3.0 mm material above; no insert, set screw, taper or keyway.
supplied_requirements.manufacturing: PETG, P1S, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, four walls and 35% infill using installed matching profiles.
supplied_requirements.tolerance: Proposed +/-0.25 mm for non-mating surfaces; socket design values remain separate from later measurements.
supplied_requirements.review_scope: Human review of socket interpretation, orientation, supports and exact final package; no physical-printer transfer or print start.
supplied_requirements.assumptions: Unvalidated intended use: 0.15 N m hand torque and 0-35 C ambient.

scallops.profile: Subtract circular arcs of radius 8.00 from the diameter-38.00 body profile; cutter centers lie on radius 24.75.

hub.placement: Concentric on front face, z=16.00 to z=18.00.

dots.placement: Two per lobe on front body face at radius 13.50; lobe centers are 30+60n degrees, with dots offset +/-8 degrees.

rounds.treatment: R1.00 on front and rear scalloped perimeter edges, hub top rim and hub root; dots smoothly domed; mating socket boundary excluded.

socket.construction: In socket-local XY, retain the radius-3.20 circle portion satisfying x>=-2.40. Shaft flat: 3.00-5.20=-2.20; move outward 0.20 to -2.40. Round radius: 3.00+0.20=3.20.
socket.placement: Concentric; opens at rear z=0 and extends toward front to z=10.00.

proposed_geometry.orientation: Rear/socket opening is z=0 and front hub is +Z. Proposed print orientation places socket opening upward and front hub on build plate; support outcome requires slicer inspection.

basis_review: Approve scallop radius, cutter-center radius, 2.25 mm depth, 33.50 mm minimum grip and phase.
Approve 12.00 x 2.00 mm hub and twelve 1.20 x 0.35 mm dots with stated placement.
Approve exposed-edge treatment and mating-socket exclusion.
Approve D-boundary derivation, flat direction, 5.60 mm cleared span and rear-to-front depth direction.
Approve socket-up orientation intent before geometry generation.
remaining_verification: Inspect actual geometry for envelope, wall thickness, rounds, manifold condition and correspondence to this basis.
Inspect slicer orientation, supports and preview, especially hub build-plate contact and socket preservation.
Verify distinct source/repaired meshes, repaired-revision binding, installed PETG/P1S profiles and final 3MF settings.
Verify package contents, digests and local simulated-transfer receipt without physical dispatch.
Later measure and test fit, dimensions, strength and print outcome; none is established by this proposal.
